entries.decision: Monorepo structure with client/ and server/ directories
entries.reason: Clear separation of frontend and backend code
Simple, file-based database perfect for personal dashboard
Widgets work without backend, seamlessly sync when available

entries.decision: Default location for WeatherWidget instead of auto-geolocation
entries.reason: Avoid browser permission warnings, use London as default
Production-ready React animation library with 120fps GPU-accelerated animations, gesture support, and spring physics

entries.decision: Crystalline Noir design system with dark amber accents
entries.reason: Distinctive aesthetic with Outfit/DM Sans fonts, noir palette, and amber (#b45309) accent colors with black text for contrast

entries.decision: Consistent modal styling with high contrast backdrop
entries.reason: bg-black/90 backdrop with bg-noir-800 modal card for clear visual separation

entries.decision: Use React Portal for Modal component
entries.reason: Prevents fixed positioning issues caused by parent transforms (whileHover animations)
